# Helix Engineering — SimuForge Token Subscription (fictional excerpt)

## Term and Renewal
Initial term: May 1, 2024 to April 30, 2027. The subscription renews automatically for twelve (12) months unless either party gives notice at least thirty (30) days before expiry.

## Token Pool
Customer purchases a pool of 70 solver tokens. When the pool is exhausted, jobs wait in queue; additional tokens may be purchased at the then-current rate.

## Price
Renewal pricing increases by seven percent (7%) per year.

## Data Retention
Helix retains simulation results for sixty (60) days after termination, after which they are deleted.
</contract>

auto_renew.quote: The subscription renews automatically for twelve (12) months unless either party gives notice at least thirty (30) days before expiry.

notice_days.quote: The subscription renews automatically for twelve (12) months unless either party gives notice at least thirty (30) days before expiry.

escalator_pct.quote: Renewal pricing increases by seven percent (7%) per year.

watch_outs: Send non-renewal notice at least 30 days before April 30, 2027 (by about March 31, 2027), or the subscription renews automatically for another 12 months.
Renewal pricing rises 7% per year, so negotiate or budget for the increase before the renewal date.
Simulation results are deleted 60 days after termination and no export method is described, so arrange to pull your data out before the contract ends.
